title: Breast Augmentation Recovery: Week-by-Week Timeline
meta_description: Usual activities in 1 to 2 weeks if no complications, full recovery in about 6 to 8, implants settle over 3 to 6 months. The sourced week-by-week timeline.
excerpt: With no complications, most usual activities return in 1 to 2 weeks. Full recovery takes about 6 to 8 weeks, and implants settle over 3 to 6 months. Here is the week-by-week timeline, what is normal, what is not, and when driving, sleep, exercise and swimming usually come back.
quick_answer:
How long is breast augmentation recovery?

The Aesthetic Society says it typically takes 1 to 2 weeks to recover, and Sientra's labeling says most usual activities return by then if you have no complications. Cleveland Clinic puts full recovery at about 6 to 8 weeks. An article on the ASPS website says implants take 3 to 6 months to settle. Your surgeon sets your dates.

Usually normal: most pain in the first 48 hours, swelling on both sides easing within a month, uneven, high or tight breasts at first, tingling or shooting pains for the first few months.
